newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - J.C. Penney seen slipping.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - J.C. Penney seen slipping.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc shares are expected to slip in early trade Thursday after the retailer said November and December gross margins were below its plan.
The company also said it expects to record operating earnings of $1.15 to $1.25 per share in the fiscal fourth quarter, before charges of $175 to $200 million related to drug store acqusitions.

"It was not unexpected, so the stock is not going to get killed, but it was not completely in the market," a trader said. Before the open, J.C. Penney was quoted at 47-1/2 bid, 48-1/4 ask, under the 48-3/4 close Tuesday.
